<!-- For vulnerabilities, follow SECURITY.md and contact support@daedlo.com privately. -->

## What happened?

Describe the expected result and what you observed. Identify whether this failed
during setup, a source check, a browser flow or installed-package acceptance.

## Reproduce

Give the smallest safe example and exact commands. Prefer the independent notebook
fixture when it reproduces the issue.

## Environment

- Daedlo version or commit:
- OS and architecture:
- Node/npm and Rust versions:
- Browser/Playwright version:

## Evidence and scope

Paste only sanitized output. Include an assertion or screenshot when useful and
state which checks passed, failed, were blocked or were not run. Remove tokens,
cookies, credentials, customer data, private paths and local update-screen URLs.
